summary: No material rules error or important omission found for original 2020 base-game standard 2–4-player multiplayer, including required two-player House Hagal.

included: Original 2020 Dune: Imperium base/core standard 2–4-player multiplayer

method.source_reading: Read the complete rulebook text through the two-player House Hagal section; read all four FAQ pages in supplied column-aware order and applied only original-base clauses. Inspected corresponding PDF text and visually inspected both Board Space Guide pages.

pdf_visual_inspection.content: Board Space Guide first page: Agent icons, Combat space labels and costs/effects.
Board Space Guide second page: Combat labels, Agent icons, costs/effects and Sell Melange graphical exchange table.

checked_claims.checked: Original base multiplayer, mandatory two-player Rival, 10 VP/empty Conflict Deck end-of-round trigger and highest VP objective.
Component counts, personal pieces, reserve composition and all ten starting cards match.
checked_claims.source_references: Rulebook PDF p.3; extracted lines 99-152

checked_claims.checked: Shuffle each tier; top-to-bottom 1 random I, 5 random II, all 4 shuffled III; unused cards returned unseen.
checked_claims.source_references: Rulebook PDF p.4; extracted lines 155-168

checked_claims.checked: Mentat/Alliances, Leaders, decks and row, starting agents, 4-player 1 VP versus other counts 0 VP, Influence cubes, 3 garrisoned troops, water, bank and first player.
checked_claims.source_references: Rulebook PDF pp.4-5; extracted lines 170-244

checked_claims.checked: Five phases; reveal Conflict/draw 5; clockwise individual turns; optional early Reveal; no later Agent turns after Reveal; Plot Intrigue timing.

checked_claims.checked: Troop eligibility, clockwise passes, consecutive passing, strength adjustment, win-trigger timing and newly won Intrigue immediate use.

checked_claims.checked: No reward at zero; normal third only in four-player; tied first takes second without a winner; tied second takes third also at two/three players; tied third gets nothing; spent troops to supply and markers to zero.

checked_claims.topic: All board spaces: costs, prerequisites and effects
checked_claims.checked: All 22 board spaces match the Guide, including High Council/Swordmaster once per player per game, delayed Hall persuasion, optional Mentat availability, city/spice/Landsraad membership.

checked_claims.checked: Ten listed Combat spaces match Guide labels: Arrakeen, Carthag, Sietch Tabr, Research Station, Imperial Basin, Hagga Basin, The Great Flat, Heighliner, Hardy Warriors, Stillsuits. Conspire and Rally Troops are not Combat spaces.

checked_claims.checked: Occupied-space redraw; correct conditional space only; reshuffle at empty deck/Reshuffle; recruits and up to two garrison troops deployed; harvest bonus returned bank; combat bonus redraw after Reshuffle, 2 per troop plus swords; ranks still block human rewards and human control removed on Rival win.

checked_claims.checked: No important in-scope setup, phase, scoring, two-player or standard board-space rule omission identified. Shared FAQ expansion/Uprising/solo clauses were not imported into original base play. Summary need not reproduce every printed card text or every narrow FAQ card entry.
checked_claims.source_references: Complete rulebook PDF pp.3-13,16-19; complete FAQ PDF pp.1-4 via supplied column-aware text
